methods: training mean mass and cosine feature
cellwise lm with and without intercept
cases.estimand: Trial response OLS on fixed features or a training-only equal-trial mean-map cosine feature; separately measured matched-map CV and cellwise normalized-map OLS.
conventions: explicit split unit and held-out group membership
training excludes held-out match groups and retains every excluded row
no intercept in trial-response fit; fixed scaled QR rank threshold 1e-12
native and historical R method/schema meanings remain distinct
robust and NNLS variants deferred; logistic on continuous mass excluded
cases.independent_case: Exact fixed-feature slopes (1,2), prediction 7 and response-700 control; learned mean (2/3,1/3), slope sqrt(5), held-out prediction 3/sqrt(2), changed held-out map prediction 1; exact rational surface OLS oracle; analytic cosine and per-fold exclusions.
cases.divergence: Native learned mean/cosine trial response regression is a named recipe, not eyesim learned-transform parity. Explicit recorded folds replace R RNG assignment; pinned CV restores the caller's RNG stream. R selects first duplicate reference and drops unmatched source rows, while native pairing retains ambiguity/missing records. Normalized cellwise OLS and trial prediction remain different estimands. PCA/CORAL/CCA and robust/NNLS variants are not claimed.
